title: Ben Roethlisberger on Steelers draft pick Drew Allar: 'Nothing jumped off the page'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ben Roethlisberger on Steelers draft pick Drew Allar: 'Nothing jumped off the page'
sources.description: Ex-Pittsburgh Steelers QB Ben Roethlisberger said Drew Allar, the team's third-round draft pick, was "nothing that jumped off the page for me."
